_comment: Planning data edited in the app. defaultSpares are starting proposals (spare parts for the whole batch, per part number); edit them freely. There are no product configurations: the first batch is one pilot, then nine, with identical hardware and firmware. Buyers choose which collections are preloaded on the card.

batches.name: First batch
batches.notes: One pilot reader (stock libros with PRs #10 and #11), then nine. Identical hardware, no J1-J3 expansion fitted. Box: two AAA cells, a prepared microSD card, a quick-start card.
